info.description: Additive bounded public-HTML collection, immutable source evidence, read-bound Codex interpretation and same-scope recheck. Existing normative Task API/DTO and full TC-029/GEO acceptance remain separate requirements. Synthetic local HTTP is explicitly labelled and is not live website or public TLS qualification.

200.description: Immutable attachment with no-store and X-Content-SHA256; format=json returns SeoResult, format=html returns the validated Codex report. Missing output is 409, unavailable identity/source is denied. Raw source containers use the existing authorized asset-version download.

SeoBudget.description: Positive HKD micros; runtime additionally enforces amount_micros <= 1000000000000 and the current plan and available balance.

SeoInput.description: Runtime normalizes URL/IDN/path values, sorts entries, rejects duplicates, ambiguous encodings, private destinations and seeds outside the confirmed scope. connection_id is currently rejected with SEO_CONNECTION_REFERENCE_UNSUPPORTED; connected Search Console metrics use the separate connector workflow.
